services.name: Tiki Boat Cruise
services.desc: Why Settle for an Ordinary Cruise? 2 hours About You can't drink and drive a boat any more than you can a car. But that doesn't mean you can't have a blast on the water! - Let Atlantic City Tiki Boat do the driving for you so you can raise your glass while you cruise. You can purchase alcohol directly from us instead of having to bring your own, which means the party doesn't stop until you say so. Our Atlantic City tiki booze cruise has room for up to 24 passengers and is US Coast Guard certified for your peace of mind. Whether you want to book a party for friends and family or just 2 Hours • Ages 21+ • A Hawaiian Tiki Party

includes: Music, snacks, and a fully-stocked bar

blurb: Guests take a 2-hour ride on a 35-foot tiki boat with music, snacks, and a fully-stocked bar. Private parties and events for up to 25 guests are available with customizable bar service. The boat has open and covered areas and a bathroom on board.
